source: Missouri Department of Health and Senior Services, MOPHIMS Death MICA (public, not logged in): Missouri Resident Deaths, county of residence by year of occurrence, one cause per query (raw per-query results saved under sources/mo_mica)
note: MICA stated rule (health.mo.gov 'Confidentiality and Suppression in the MOPHIMS System'): suppression threshold is four; values 1-4 (zero excluded) trigger suppression, applied to whole rows by default; when only one or two rows trigger it, the three rows with the lowest totals are also suppressed (complementary). The table marks them 'x' ('the confidentiality rule has been triggered'); the page states no threshold on the table itself. Counts of 5 and above and explicit zeros are published. x cells are NOT in `data`. `x_cells` lists every x (cause -> year -> counties). `narrow_1_4` lists only x cells from tables where 6 or more rows were x (complementary suppression adds at most the three lowest-total rows to one or two triggering rows, so 6+ x rows are all real triggers, every x a true 1-4) and where shown counts plus 4 per x row still reach the state total; x cells from tables with 1-5 x rows may include complementary-suppressed larger values and are NOT narrowable. One cause and one year per query, because MICA suppresses a whole county row if any cell in the row triggers, which would hide most counties in a multi-year table. Cause groupings follow MICA's 113-cause list: accidents (unintentional injuries), falls (accidental, node 111), firearm pieces (accidental 112, suicide 119, homicide 123, undetermined 128; `firearm` = their sum where all four are shown; legal-intervention firearm not included), overdose = MICA's 'Drug Overdose' variable (accidental poisoning 115 + suicide by drug 121 + assault by drug 125 + undetermined-intent drug overdose 132). 'accidents' has no MortalGIS measure yet; 'all' maps to all_deaths.
